text: Both runs are still going. They're walking the pages with Tab.

I tested both pages. Each has one confirmed FAIL (3.3.2), and most other criteria are still NEEDS_REVIEW.

- **Cross-page comparisons:** These could not run. The tool recorded both URLs as having the same content, so it would have been comparing a page with itself. That leaves 2.4.1, 2.4.5, 3.2.3 and 3.2.4 as NEEDS_REVIEW on both pages.
- **Keyboard and focus tests:** These did not finish, so 2.1.1, 2.1.2 and 2.4.7 are NEEDS_REVIEW. 2.4.3 and 3.2.1 are also NEEDS_REVIEW because I left some of their questions unanswered.
- **2.2.2:** The moving-content test was DNA, but the auto-updating check could not run, so I put NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **3.2.2:** The search box changes part of the page when filled in. I could not open the before/after images, so this stays NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **2.4.3 and 3.2.1:** I did not open the focus-order image, and I did not open some of the hover-card images. The ones I looked at showed small profile cards. Both stay NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **3.3.2 (FAIL):** The search fields have only gray placeholder text as a label, which disappears when you type.
  - Home: the global search combobox, "Global search across forum, events, and announcements".
  - Forum: the same global search, plus the "Search posts by keywords" combobox.
- **1.3.1 and 4.1.2 (form-field parts):** The tool passed both pages; the fields have accessible names, including the event button. These checks don't cover the missing visible labels, which are reported under 3.3.2.
- **2.4.6:** The tool returned DNA because no field has a visible label. I set it to NEEDS_REVIEW because the fields do have accessible names.
- **3.3.1, 3.3.3 and 3.3.4:** I marked these DNA. The only forms are search boxes that accept any input and show no error, and none is consequential.
